evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/ipd-s772/<planId>/ with final/ and attempt-<n>/ subdirectories. tmp/ is git-ignored and holds only data (logs, JSON, digests, PNG exports and comparison images); never authored source. Cargo output goes to target/ and the sidecar to apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/, declared as artifactRoots only by the plans that build them, which are ordered by dependsOn.

reviewContext.userProblem: An iPhone app design drawn with nodetto-cli 0.8.9 came out misaligned and sloppy. Defects D1-D10: ui.control ignores textAlign (D1); tabs ignore fill/stroke/accent and options are not styleable (D2); newline labels render monospace on one line (D3); geo rects under 3 units vanish (D4); no precise text layer, text.note ignores fontSize/fontWeight on update (D5); no icon element (D6); elements added inside a frame are not its children and nothing clips or snaps (D7); auto layout cannot be driven from the CLI (D8); prototype links are drawn across artboards with verbose labels and there is no prototype view, flow start, storyboard or presentation (D9); frame titles overlap content and there is no easy per-frame side-by-side comparison (D10).
requiredOutcomes: Decision 1: precise text layer on text.note (text:layer shape, no implicit padding, auto-width/auto-height/fixed, alignment, font size/weight, line height, letter spacing, color, single-line ellipsis, honored on add and update).

Decision 2: ui.icon element backed by vendored Lucide (ISC) with LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, name lookup from palette and `nodetto-cli shapes icon <query>`, size/color/stroke width, custom SVG path icons.
Decision 3: dividers and borders of any thickness >= 0.5 render; per-side borders and stroke alignment.

Decision 4: ui.control honors alignment, padding, font, color, radius, leading/trailing icons; tabs/segmented with underline and pill indicators, selected/unselected colors, per-option overrides; badges.
Decision 5: iOS component kit on the component/instance system with overridable properties, insertable by ios:<name> shape ID from palette and CLI.

Decision 6: frame auto-parenting (CLI add with parent or by containment), children move with frame, clip content, safe-area and layout-grid guides, iPhone presets including 390x844 and 402x874, titles above the artboard.
Decision 7: CLI layout/sizing (direction, gap, padding, alignment, hug/fill/fixed, absolute children), align, distribute, snap, and an 8/4 point desktop snap grid.

Decision 8: Figma-style prototyping concepts: hotspot or frame links with trigger/action (incl. back, swap-overlay)/animation, prototype view toggle with curved compact links, named flow starts, storyboard overview, desktop and HTML click-through presentation with persistent elements.
Decision 9: app-design lint (off-frame, text overflow/truncation, overlapping controls, off-grid, misaligned siblings, touch targets under 44 points).
Decision 10: export of all frames of a page as individual PNGs and a side-by-side comparison helper in CLI (`compare`) and desktop app.

Item 11: reproduction of the ten private reference screens built only through nodetto-cli operations into the operator-named git-ignored output directory, validate and app lint with zero findings, prototype links and one flow start, per-frame PNGs compared side by side with every reference screenshot (drift <= 4 points, correct icons, colors and type).
Generic iPhone sample under examples/ exercising the kit and prototype flows; CLI help and docs for AI agents.
TypeScript and native Rust CLI parity covered by mise run test-cli; final gates mise run verify, test-cli, build-cli and typecheck with no new failures versus the ipd-00 baseline.
nonGoals: No server, auth or deployment code (public repo).
No proprietary Figma assets or internal names; concepts only.
No schemaVersion bump or migration; all additions are optional fields plus the ui.icon type and two prototype action values.
No new native Rust host primitive is planned; parity comes from running shared TypeScript in the Boa-hosted CLI.
No push, merge, rebase, release, signing or upload; no changes to other repos or worktrees.
No tracked copy of any private reference material (names, texts, colors, screenshots).
constraints: Work only in /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/nodetto-app-iphone-design on feat/iphone-app-design from f59bef4; gitPush false.
Privacy: reference and reproduction directories stay under git-ignored tmp/; ipd-28 scans tracked and untracked files against tmp/ipd-s772/ipd-27-reproduction/private-terms.txt.
AGENTS.md: CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, no emojis, stage by explicit path, no tool attribution in commits.
Existing documents stay valid and render byte-identically except the rows in the design's Accepted output changes table.
Problems outside a unit's writePaths are findings, never blockers; finding statuses use the fixed vocabulary.
Broad suites gate on no new failures versus the ipd-00 Baseline failures table with explicit excludes.
Visual evidence is mandatory for rendering/UI work: export PNGs with the built CLI and inspect them.
packages/core/src/index.ts and packages/ui-solid/src/index.ts are append-only shared files: re-read before writing, never reorder or remove lines.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 1: blocked-wave-scope-or-contract operator amendment for session-772 wave 2 blockers: (a) ipd-01-ir-schema owns packages/ir/src/registry.test.ts and updates its complete ELEMENT_TYPES expectation to include ui.icon; (b) ipd-03-icon-data pins lucide-static 1.70.0 (the release already downloaded and recorded) and the generator accepts a `fill` attribute on child geometry elements only with the values `currentColor` or `none`; it stores a per-node `fill` flag, the markup renders `fill="currentColor"` nodes filled with the icon color (and `none` as unfilled, the default), and any other fill value still fails the script with the icon name; (c) ipd-00-baseline, ipd-02-text-measure, ipd-04-cli-edit-contracts and ipd-29-desktop-snap-grid are accepted dependencies whose code is already in the working tree; do not redo them.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plans: ipd-01-ir-schema and ipd-03-icon-data (gaps resolved: registry.test.ts ownership; lucide-static version pin and fill allowlist). ipd-01 could not pass `bun test packages/ir` because registry.test.ts asserts the full element-type list and was outside its writePaths. Lucide 1.70.0 (latest stable) has fill="currentColor" on a child of brain-circuit.svg (a filled dot); rejecting it would block the whole icon set, while a two-value fill flag keeps the strict allowlist and renders the icon as upstream intends. The run died at wave-2 reconcile from a network outage (ENOTFOUND), not a code failure.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 2 (integration-paths-outside-writePaths, session-775 checkpoint amendment): ipd-01-ir-schema owns packages/io/src/jsonl/golden.test.ts (append exactly one GOLDEN entry "ui-icon" at the end; nothing else) and the new fixture packages/io/src/__fixtures__/ui-icon.jsonl (one page with two ui.icon elements: semantic {icon:"bell"} and {path:"M0 0L24 24",viewBox:24}, canonical bytes produced by serializeDocument(parseDocument(...))). No existing fixture is modified, the coverage assertion is not loosened, and ui.icon semantics and registry order are unchanged. apps/cli/src/edit/label-field.test.ts stays with ipd-07-icon-core-cli: it reads defaultSemantic() from the core shape registry, which ipd-07 supplies through packages/core/src/shapes/ui-icon.ts, so no test edit is authorized.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Integration review finding integration-s775-w1-golden-ui-icon (mid): ipd-01 registered ui.icon in ELEMENT_TYPES, so golden.test.ts 'covers every registered element type at least once' fails with missing ["ui.icon"], and no plan owned packages/io. The failure blocks mise run verify and ipd-28. The fix is the smallest one that restores the gate and pins ui.icon serialization round-trip.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 2 (ordering, Step 5 finding S5-R2-IPD08-GATE): ipd-08-cli-layout-ops dependsOn gains ipd-07-icon-core-cli (wave 3 -> 5) and reruns its unchanged verification aggregate (including apps/cli/src/edit) after ipd-07 is accepted; its layout source edits are already in the working tree and are not reimplemented. ipd-07-icon-core-cli verification step 1 adds apps/cli/src/edit/label-field.test.ts (expect exit 0, 0 fail) and an acceptance line that the ui.icon defaultSemantic {icon:"square"} validates. label-field.test.ts is run only, never edited, skipped or loosened; writePaths of both plans are unchanged and disjoint.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: label-field.test.ts creates every ELEMENT_TYPES entry from the core registry defaultSemantic(); ui.icon is registered by ipd-01 but its core shape comes only from ipd-07 (packages/core/src/shapes/ui-icon.ts), so ipd-08's aggregate could not exit 0 in wave 3 and the owner had no gate on the failing test. Only ipd-23, ipd-24 and ipd-25 depend on ipd-08 and they already follow ipd-07, so no downstream plan is delayed.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 3: operator ipd-07a split (session-775 wave 2 blocker, blocked-wave-scope-or-contract):ipd-01-ir-schema is accepted (IR 156/156, golden 57/57, typecheck clean). New root unit ipd-07a-icon-shape takes the minimal ui.icon core shape util (defaultSemantic {icon: "square"}) and its createDefaultRegistry registration out of ipd-07; ipd-05, ipd-06, ipd-07, ipd-09 and ipd-12 depend on it; ipd-07 keeps SVG export, warnings, catalogue and CLI work and treats ui-icon.ts as a shared path.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: apps/cli/src/edit/label-field.test.ts creates every registered element type from its core default; with the IR type registered but no core util, ui.icon's fallback default lacks icon/path and createElement throws, so every unit running bun test packages apps/cli/src before ipd-07 failed the progress gate. ipd-01 could not fix it inside its IR scope.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Step 4 rerun 2026-11-10 (session-777): the operator round-3 split is normalized without scope change. ipd-07a-icon-shape gets the standard ownership block and plan contract; ipd-07's markdown drops the prose writePaths entry and lists packages/core/src/shapes/ui-icon.ts as a sharedPath with a note; ipd-05, ipd-06, ipd-07, ipd-08, ipd-09 and ipd-12 headers name ipd-07a (directly or via ipd-07) and accepted dependencies separately, with dated round-3 amendment sections; waves recomputed (ipd-07a 1; ipd-05, ipd-06 2; ipd-07, ipd-09, ipd-12 3; ipd-08 4). ipd-08 keeps dependsOn ipd-07 (the Step 5 S5-R2-IPD08-GATE repair) and ipd-07 keeps label-field.test.ts in its verification. The tmp plan-check inputs are resynced and check-md.ts matches ipd-NNx plan files.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Step 5 S5-R2-IPD08-GATE and S5-R2-L1 required the ordering repair to be explicit and the checkers to exit 0; the operator round-3 working-tree amendment left a prose path entry in ipd-07 and a non-standard ipd-07a header that the markdown checker could not parse.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 4 (session-779 waves 3-4): ipd-07a-icon-shape, ipd-05-core-catalogue, ipd-06-geo-strokes, ipd-09-text-layer and ipd-12-controls are accepted dependencies. ipd-07-icon-core-cli unknown-icon rule is: `Did you mean: a, b, c?` only when searchIcons(name, 5) returns at least one match; otherwise `Search with nodetto-cli shapes icon <query>`. Its edit test cases are therefore: `icon:bel` -> exit 2 (EXIT_ERROR), message contains `Did you mean` and `bell`; `icon:not-an-icon` -> exit 2 (EXIT_ERROR), message contains `unknown icon` and `Search with nodetto-cli shapes icon`. Keep the ipd-07 work already in the working tree and continue from it. Unknown-icon edit operations use the existing operation-error path and exit 2; exit 1 is EXIT_DRIFT and the CLI exit-code contract does not change.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The ipd-07 plan required search guidance when there are no matches but also required `icon:not-an-icon` (which has no matches) to report `Did you mean`; the implementer followed the no-match rule and the unit blocked twice on the contradiction (session-779 waves 3 and 4). In wave 4 the corrected plan still said exit 1, contradicting the CLI contract (EXIT_ERROR 2, EXIT_DRIFT 1), and the unit blocked again.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 4 Step 5 s781 repairs (accepted): ipd-28 step 7 emoji gate runs rg directly over git diff --name-only f59bef4 plus git ls-files -o --exclude-standard with a whitespace precheck and positive control (IPD-R5); new plan ipd-07b-icon-data-ascii (dependsOn ipd-07-icon-core-cli) escapes non-ASCII code units in scripts/vendor-lucide.ts output and regenerates packages/core/src/icons/lucide-data.generated.ts from tmp/ipd-s772/ipd-03-icon-data/src/package with an unchanged runtime hash; ipd-23-parity-shapes dependsOn gains ipd-07b so ipd-24, 26, 27 and 28 follow it; ipd-07 fixes one exit code per outcome (search no match 0, unknown icon 2, exit 1 banned) (IPD-R6).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Step 5 (session-781) accepted the repairs: the repaired ipd-28 gate found raw emoji in the accepted ipd-03 output (rg -c gives 1 matching line in lucide-data.generated.ts); excluding the vendored file would hide real matches, so a dedicated owner plan is the smallest correct choice. ipd-07 had conflicting exit-code text.
